chapter.verse: Ahih hangin mite lakah kamsang zuau hong piang mah bangin a kikhenthang thei up khialhna ngeina, kheemna tawh guangin, amau pumpi uh a lei Topa nangawn nialin, amau tungah a manlangin kisiatna a tungsak thu zuau hilh siate in note lakah zong a om ding uh hi.
Amau kihhuai gamtatnate mi tampi in mangin, thuman thutak lampi kosiatna a thuaksak ding uh hi.
Amaute huaiham luatna in zuau thu genna tawh note hong kheem ding uh hi. Amaute tungah thukhenna in tang lai-a kipanin ol lo, zekai lo a, amaute kisiatna in zong a ihmu kei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian in a khial vantungmite pammaih sa loin, hel khua sungah a khiat khit ciangin thukhen Ni dongin khuamial khuk sungah a khum hi.
Tang lai leitung zong pammaihsa loin, dikna thu a hilh Noah leh mi sagihte keem a, Pasian bia lote leitungah tuicin a tumsak hi.
Sodom leh Gomorrah khuapite, mei vut suakin, cip siatna daan thu khen a, a nung ciangin Pasian bia lote adingin limin a koih hi.
Tua lai takin mi gilote’ kihhuai gamtatna hangin bawlsiatna a thuak, midik Lot a gumkhia hi.
Tua midik pa in amaute lakah a omkhawm lai takin, amaute’ gitloh gamtatna ni simin a mit tawh mu-in, a bil tawh za ahih manin ama dikna lungsim nakpi-in a buai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Pasian a biate ze-etna sung pan gumkhia ding ahi zongin,

atak takin ci leeng kihhuai deihgawhna tawh pumpi deihna zui-in, ukna thusim lo-a a dik lo mite thu a khen Ni dongin daantatsakin kikhum nading ahi zongin ahih thei hi. Tua mite in lau loin amau deihna a zui thei mi hi uh a, a lian a ukte a kosia ngam uh hi.
Vantungmite in ahih uh leh, amaute sangin a hat zawk, a vangliat zawk uh hangin Pasian mai-ah amaute in kosiatna mawhsakna a bawl kei uh hi.

Hih mite ahih uh leh, ngaihsut pilna nei lo ganhingte bangin ahi uh a, siatna a thuak ganhingte taktak bangin amaute in a theih tel loh uh nate kosia-in, a siatsak uh hangin, kisiatna a man takin tungin,

gitlohna thaman ahi gitloh bawlna a thuak ding uh hi. Tua mite in sun lai takin pawikham uh a, noptatin a om uh hi. Note tawh pawi a kham uh ciangin amau kheemna tawh noptat lua-in a nin baang kinuh mi ahi uh hi.

Amaute in mi’ zi tungah mawh nop lunggulhna tawh a dim uh a, a kham thei lo mittang nei mi ahi uh hi. A kip lo mite a zol thei uh hi; huaiham luatna-ah a siam thei lungsim nei-in, hamsiatna’ tate ahi uh hi.
Amaute in thuman thutak lam pan pialin, a mangthang uh a, Beora’ tapa Balaam’ lampi a zui uh hi. Tua Balaam in a hoih lo gamtatna thaman deihgawh a,
ama mawhna hangin taaina a thuak hi. Bang ci-a thuak hiam na cih uh leh, kam a pau thei lo la khat in, mi kam pau tawh pau-in tua kamsangpa’ haina a kham hi.
Tua mite in tui om lo-a a kang cikte ahi zongin, huih nakpi-in nunga a leeng meiite ahi uh hi. Amaute ading a mial pha mahmah khuamial a kikoih khol zo hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, khialhna ahih thei mite sung pan a taisuak dek takte tungah kisaktheihna kam mawkna genin pumpi deihna lunggulh luatna tawh, mawhna-ah a zol thei uh hi.
Amaute pumpi uh kisiatna’ sila ahi napi-in, “Suahtakna ka hong pia ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi a zo thei na in tua mi’ topa ahi hi.
I Topa leh Honpa Zeisu Khazih theihtelna hangin leitung kihhuaina tawh a suahtak khit uh ciangin, khat vei awk kikin a lelh uh leh, a nung ciangin a pian’ in a pian’masak sangin a gilo zaw hi.
Dikna thu lampi a theih khit uh ciangin thukham siangtho a paaikhia kik sangin tua lampi thei loin a om uh leh, amau ading a pha zaw hi.
‘Ui in ama luak a ne kik hi; vokpi in a kisil khit ciangin buan lakah a bual kik hi,’ ci-in a man thugentehna bangin tua mite tungah a piang zo hi.
